context: Two managers prep a corporate initiative meeting
purpose: Teach: 月額/採決/取組/拠出/強行/承り/隊長/棟

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今回の取組、月額予算で運営できるか、要確認。
lines.en: We need to confirm whether this initiative can actually run on the monthly budget.
lines.style: Crisp, businesslike tone. Quick tempo. Matter-of-fact opening. No softening — this is a practical checklist item, not a request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 拠出する各部の比率、強行採決にならないよう調整中です。
lines.en: I'm working on adjusting each department's contribution ratio so we don't end up forcing a vote through.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring. Slightly lower register — reporting progress, not rushing. Warm competence. Careful on the adjustment logic, like he's thought this through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 担当隊長から、承りますの返信が早く欲しい。
lines.en: I need a quick confirmation from the team lead — as soon as possible.
lines.style: Measured urgency. Light emphasis on 'quick'. Not demanding, but clear about priority. The tone of someone who knows what needs to happen next.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本日中に届く見込みです。新棟見学も同時にセットします。
lines.en: It should come through by end of day. I'll coordinate the new building tour at the same time.
lines.style: Efficient, reassuring. Brisk but not rushed. Each item checked off. Slight lift at the end — demonstrating he's already in motion.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Quiet, brief nod of acknowledgment. Warm enough to close the exchange without lingering. The exhale of someone moving to the next thing.
